description: MLIT records person-trip origin–destination totals between zones in the Tokyo, Kinki and Chukyo metropolitan areas. Flows are classified by trip purpose and representative transport mode. The source lists Tokyo 2008, Kinki 2000 and 2010, and Chukyo 2001 and 2011 surveys, incorporated into releases dated 2010 to 2013. Lines connect zone centres and carry the aggregated flow attributes. Zone definitions differ between metropolitan areas. These survey flows can support transport-demand and network-flow models, but the lines are statistical connections between zones and do not establish the routes actually travelled. The provider also records zone information; the separate S05-a product focuses on generation and attraction totals. The provider supplies GML and Shapefile metadata and download links. Access is free under the National Land Numerical Information terms; the page restricts this edition to non-commercial use. Only the catalogue metadata was reviewed. Dataset files and their current contents were not downloaded. The related parent record is the MLIT National Land Numerical Information catalogue.
